meta.title: Dealer Portal — Demo Consumer Distribution Co.
meta.description: Enterprise Platform Phase 7 WEB-03 demo — an authenticated B2B dealer portal: real per-dealer pricing, stock, orders, invoices, debt and returns, backed by real Frappe session login and per-dealer permission scoping.

login.heading: Dealer Portal
login.subtitle: Sign in with your dealer account to see your own pricing, stock, orders, invoices, debt position and returns.
login.demoAccessIntro: Try it now with real seeded demo accounts — no real business data at stake.
login.footerNote: This is a public demo platform — use the Demo Access credentials above to explore freely.
